name: Median

ancestors.notes: Northwestern Iranian branch of Indo-European; shares phonological isoglosses with Avestan rather than Old Persian (Schmitt 2021, Encyclopaedia Iranica).

notes: Stub: no citable grapheme-to-IPA inventory, and no direct attestation exists to source one from. Extinct Iranian language of the Median Empire (1st millennium BCE, western Iran); no Median-language texts survive. Everything known about Median is inferred indirectly from Median loanwords embedded in Old Persian inscriptions and from onomastics preserved in Greek and Elamite sources (Schmitt 2021; Tavernier 2007) -- there is no Median script or orthography to describe. Adding a grapheme table here would fabricate a writing system that never existed for the language; `graphemes` stays empty and `script` records the honest 'Unattested' status rather than borrowing a neighboring script.
